subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 remain as one umbrella, or should maintainers split it into narrow core routing/activity issues plus a separate WeChat plugin/live-repro item?
rationale: The report spans core TUI defaults, gateway sessions_send routing, session list semantics, external WeChat ownership, and background-event isolation, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Split into focused work
options.body: Use #93255 and #51028 as canonical narrow core items, then create or route a separate live-repro item for WeChat identity and flood isolation.

options.title: Keep umbrella tracking
options.body: Keep #88204 open as the parent issue until all four reported symptoms have a maintainer-approved disposition.

options.title: Close after satellite confirmation
options.body: Close #88204 only after maintainers confirm every remaining symptom is owned by a narrower open issue or external plugin tracker.

recommendation.title: Split into focused work
recommendation.body: Use #93255 and #51028 as canonical narrow core items, then create or route a separate live-repro item for WeChat identity and flood isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent main history shows broad ownership across the gateway, session organization, TUI, and session-store paths needed to choose the split.
